_meta.note: GRID VERIFIED 2026-08-07 (grid drawn over the PNG at 9-15x - lines land exactly on tile edges; 288x800 / 16 = 18x50 = 900 frames, no remainder). Desert pack OBJECT sheet (the terrain counterpart is desert-autotile). No autotile sets here - everything is a named region. KEY STRUCTURE: the sheet is TWO 9-COLUMN HALVES carrying the same layout in two materials, so cols 0-8 and cols 9-17 mirror each other. The material pairing FLIPS between bands: rows 0-10 are grey stone on the left and warm sand on the right; rows 23-46 are warm sand on the left and pale stone on the right. Region names carry -stone / -sand accordingly. ROW-BAND TRIAGE: rows 0-10 sand basins, cave mouths, pillars, rubble and small props (mirrored); row 11 empty gutter; rows 12-22 flora and market awnings - palms, saguaro, barrel cacti, shrubs (NOT mirrored, one set); rows 23-34 building facades - beam headers, doorways, stone insets, wall bodies and arches (mirrored); rows 35-46 a thatched-roof kit - plank wall, roof, roof edge and doors, where the green thatch is shared and only the gable face and door change material (mirrored); rows 47-49 pottery - crate, clay pots, tall vases and round pots (NOT mirrored).
